description: Every HTML route on bqk-kos.org tested (statistikat/serite-kohore, statistikat/, sitemap.xml, wp-sitemap.xml) returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge, both via WebFetch and via curl with a realistic desktop User-Agent.

result.result_summary: HTML pages not retrievable by simple HTTP clients; this is bot mitigation, NOT evidence the pages are dead. robots.txt itself returned HTTP 200 and permits general crawling (only /wp-admin/, /wp-includes/, plugins, themes, /tmp/, /private/ disallowed) with Crawl-delay: 10, so the site policy invites crawling even though the WAF blocks naive clients.

why_it_matters: The collection pipeline for this cell must budget for a headless-browser fetcher for CBK HTML pages. Treat all CBK HTML URLs in this slice as unverified-but-probably-live.

description: Static file endpoints on the same domain are NOT challenged: HEAD requests to /repository/docs/SistemiIPagesave/Perdorimi%20i%20kartelave%20ne%20Kosove.pdf and /wp-content/uploads/2024/11/CBK_MSB_251_en.pdf both returned HTTP 200 with content-type application/pdf (690 KB and 7.46 MB respectively).

result.result_summary: PDF/asset harvesting works with an ordinary HTTPS client; only link discovery needs a browser.

why_it_matters: Two-stage collection is viable and cheap: browser-based discovery of links, plain-HTTP bulk download of the documents themselves.

description: No dedicated, separately-navigable 'payment system statistics' dataset page with downloadable card/ATM/POS time series could be confirmed. Searches surfaced only (a) the thematic PDF 'Përdorimi i kartelave në Kosovë', (b) references stating that payment-system data sits inside the Monthly Statistical Bulletin, and (c) a legacy aggregate route (?id=125) described as holding 'publikime statistikore, analiza dhe materiale tjera informative nga Sistemi i Pagesave'.

result.result_summary: Card/ATM/POS series appear to be embedded in the bulletin and the annual report rather than exposed as a standalone dataset.

why_it_matters: A4 card/ATM/POS extraction for XK will likely require table extraction from bulletin PDFs rather than downloading a ready-made series — plan parsing effort accordingly.

description: No open API, SDMX endpoint, or bulk-download interface was found for the CBK time series; all evidence points to per-table XLSX/PDF downloads only.

result.result_summary: No programmatic statistical API identified for BQK.

why_it_matters: Rules out API-based ingestion; the collector must be file-based with change detection.

description: Serbian-language coverage of the specifically payments/card/ATM/POS material was thin. Serbian searching resolved the institutional and macro layer (Mesečni Statistički Bilten, Odeljenje za statistiku, CBK_VTE quarterly, finansijska stabilnost pages) but returned no Serbian equivalent of 'Përdorimi i kartelave në Kosovë'.

result.result_summary: sr coverage exists for core statistics and macro reports but was not confirmed for the payments-thematic publications.

why_it_matters: If sr-language payments material matters to the consumer of this research, it may need to be requested from the CBK directly or reconstructed from the sr bulletin; do not assume trilingual parity for every document.

description: The CBK site has migrated at least twice: legacy query-string routes (index.php?id=47, ?id=57, ?id=125), a legacy /repository/docs/ file tree, and a current WordPress structure (/statistikat/, /publikimet/, /wp-content/uploads/YYYY/MM/) all coexist, with both www and non-www hostnames in circulation.

result.result_summary: Multiple parallel URL generations serve live content simultaneously.

why_it_matters: Link-rot risk is real and a single 404 must not be read as a dead source. A crawler for this cell should try the legacy route family and both hostnames before declaring anything gone, and should keep a URL-alias map.

description: Every fetch attempt against bqk-kos.org and www.bqk-kos.org (HTML pages and PDFs alike) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.

result.result_summary: Six distinct URLs attempted across page and PDF paths, all 403. Search indexes show current content on the same URLs, so this reads as bot defence / UA filtering rather than dead links. Recorded as unverified, not dead.

why_it_matters: The primary source for this entire cell is behind a fetch barrier; the collector must be built around a headless browser or realistic-UA client from day one, and liveness verification must not treat 403 as death.

description: No standalone, separately titled 'Annual Payment Systems Report' for Kosovo was located.

result.result_summary: Albanian queries for 'Raporti Vjetor i Sistemit të Pagesave' returned only the CBK Annual Report (which contains a payment chapter), the Financial Stability Report, and the retail-payments strategy. No dedicated annual payment-systems report surfaced.

why_it_matters: The cell hypothesis of a distinct annual payments report may be wrong for XK: the payment-system narrative appears to live inside the Annual Report, the FSR, the 'Use of Bank Cards' study and NPC minutes instead. Collection design should target those four rather than hunting a report that may not exist.

description: No machine-readable (XLS/XLSX/CSV/API) payment-systems dataset was positively identified for Kosovo from the CBK.

result.result_summary: All confirmed CBK payment artefacts found in this pass are PDFs. The 'Seritë kohore' portal is the plausible home of spreadsheets but could not be opened (403), so its contents remain a hypothesis.

why_it_matters: If the CBK publishes payments only as PDF, the pipeline needs table extraction and the IMF FAS series becomes the structured fallback for terminal counts.

description: The interbank system's naming is inconsistent across sources: SPN (Sistemi i Pagesave Ndërbankare), KIPS (Kosovo Interbank Payment System), and the cell's own 'KIS/ATS' shorthand.

result.result_summary: CBK regulation uses 'Sistemi i Pagesave Ndërbankare (SPN)'; English-language summaries use 'KIPS'. No evidence was found of an 'ATS' branding in Kosovo (that acronym belongs to other jurisdictions).

why_it_matters: Query sets built on 'KIS' or 'ATS' will under-recall. Local-language collection must key on 'SPN', 'sistemi i pagesave ndërbankare', 'klerim', and 'KIPS'.

description: The Kosovo Banking Association's canonical domain could not be confirmed.

result.result_summary: Two candidate domains appeared in secondary text (bankassoc-ks.org, bankassoc-kos.com) but neither was corroborated by a first-party result; only a member bank's description page was found.

why_it_matters: The association is a plausible aggregator of sector card/channel statistics; leaving its domain unresolved leaves an industry-side gap next to the regulator-side coverage.

description: No Kosovo-specific card-scheme or processor disclosure (Visa/Mastercard country data, national switch operator, third-party acquirer/processor) was located.

result.result_summary: Searches on card statistics returned only CBK publications and one Kenyan central bank page as noise; no XK acquiring/processing entity published terminal or transaction statistics in the results seen.

why_it_matters: Scheme- and processor-side data would be the independent commercial cross-check on CBK terminal counts; its absence means the supply side rests almost entirely on the regulator plus bank annual reports.

description: No Diebold Nixdorf press release, case study or customer reference naming a Kosovo bank was found, despite Kosovo estates plausibly containing legacy Wincor Nixdorf hardware.

result.result_summary: Searches returned only generic global cash-recycling and DN Series portfolio content; no Kosovo mention.

why_it_matters: The largest OEM in the region publishes nothing Kosovo-specific, so installed-base evidence for Kosovo must come from the integrator layer (Printec, Payten) or from the banks themselves, not from OEM newsrooms.

description: No evidence found that Euronet or any other independent ATM deployer (IAD) operates a non-bank ATM network in Kosovo.

result.result_summary: Euronet IAD expansion releases enumerate many European markets (Iceland, Baltics, Norway, Montenegro, Spain, Italy, Belgium) but Kosovo did not appear in any release surfaced.

why_it_matters: Suggests Kosovo's ATM estate is essentially entirely bank-owned, which means CBK ATM counts and bank disclosures should reconcile without an IAD residual — a useful structural assumption to state and to monitor for change.

description: Serbian-language searching for Kosovo ATM/POS vendor and contract terms produced no Kosovo-relevant vendor sources.

result.result_summary: Cyrillic queries (банкомат, добављач, терминали, платни систем + Kosovo) returned only Serbian and North Macedonian bank general-conditions and internet-banking pages; nothing about Kosovo terminal supply.

why_it_matters: Vendor communications aimed at Kosovo appear to be published in Albanian and English only; Serbian-language vendor discovery for this cell has near-zero yield and should be deprioritised in favour of sq/en, except possibly for banks serving Serb-majority municipalities.

description: No public tender award or contract notice naming an ATM/POS supplier to a Kosovo commercial bank was located.

result.result_summary: Tender-aggregator results (globaltenders, tendersinfo) surfaced but contained no accessible Kosovo bank ATM/POS award; commercial banks in Kosovo are private and not subject to public procurement publication.

why_it_matters: Confirms that procurement transparency is not a viable route to vendor-bank linkage for commercial banks here; only CBK's own procurement and vendor self-disclosure remain. Sets expectations for this cell's collection design.

description: Printec Group corporate site returned HTTP 403 and Asseco SEE contacts page returned a redirect loop to automated fetching.

result.result_summary: Both are almost certainly live and bot-defended/consent-gated rather than dead; content was corroborated via search snippets and third-party indexes.

why_it_matters: Two of the highest-value vendor sources for this cell need a browser-based collector rather than a plain HTTP fetcher; a naive pipeline would wrongly mark them dead.

description: No Kosovo customer reference found for the major switch/card-management vendors BPC (SmartVista), OpenWay (Way4), Nexi/SIA, or Tietoevry.

result.result_summary: Multi-vendor searches returned only non-Kosovo case studies; the only confirmed Kosovo card-platform evidence is Compass Plus TranzWare at Quipu's Kosovo processing centre.

why_it_matters: The Kosovo issuing/acquiring platform landscape is largely undocumented publicly; TranzWare/Quipu is the single confirmed anchor and should be treated as the starting node for snowballing rather than assuming regional-vendor defaults.

description: No Albanian-language Kosovo media outlet was found that maintains a standing, structured tracker of ATM/POS network counts (e.g. a recurring 'numri i bankomatëve' data page or series). Media mention such counts only episodically inside articles about BQK releases.

result.result_summary: Searches on 'numri i bankomatëve në Kosovë statistika' returned BQK/ASK institutional pages and an academic thesis, not media data series.

why_it_matters: ATM/POS network counts will have to be reconstructed article-by-article from scattered media mentions plus BQK's 'Përdorimi i kartelave në Kosovë' publication; no journalistic shortcut exists.

description: Ekonomia Online, the most obvious Albanian-language Kosovo business-news brand for this cell, was named in aggregated result text but no article URL on the ekonomiaonline.com domain was returned by two targeted queries in this pass.

result.result_summary: Two queries explicitly scoping the domain returned only Wikipedia, bank sites and BQK pages.

why_it_matters: A likely-central outlet remains unverified; its exact domain and section structure must be confirmed before it is added to a collection schedule.

description: Serbian-language Kosovo media (e.g. KoSSev, Kosovo Online, Radio KIM) were probed with a Serbian query about ATM/bank statistics but no Serbian-language media article was returned — results were entirely BQK's own Serbian-language site.

result.result_summary: Query 'Kosovo banke bankomati statistike CBK izveštaj kosovo-online kossev srpski' returned only bqk-kos.org ?lang=sr pages and Wikipedia.

why_it_matters: Serbian-language reporting on north-Kosovo banking (branch closures, dinar/euro cash handling, ATM availability) is a distinct information stream this pass did not reach; it is likely covered by a different cell but should not be assumed covered.

description: The routine playbook path given in the brief (C:/Users/User/Dropbox/... routine_prompt.md) is a Windows path and is not present on this macOS machine, so the full method document could not be read.

result.result_summary: Path not accessible from this environment.

why_it_matters: Classification conventions were inferred from the task brief alone; field semantics may diverge slightly from the canonical playbook.

description: A single BQK-derived story (bank loans / deposits) was found verbatim on at least three different domains (lajmi.net, vushtrriaonline.net, joq-albania.com), and the cash-limit story on at least five.

result.result_summary: Identical headlines across unrelated domains.

why_it_matters: Any collection pipeline for this cell needs aggressive near-duplicate detection and an origin-attribution step, or figure counts will be double-counted and false 'corroboration' will be inferred.

description: No source was found — in sr, sq or en — that publishes payment, card, ATM or POS statistics disaggregated by municipality or by Serbian-majority area within Kosovo. CBK series appear to be Kosovo-wide; NBS series are Serbia-wide and exclude Kosovo territory operationally.

result.result_summary: Searches on bankomati/kartično poslovanje/severna Mitrovica surfaced only Kosovo-aggregate CBK reports and commercial ATM-locator pages, no municipal breakdown.

why_it_matters: The core quantitative question of this cell — how payments actually behave in Serbian-majority municipalities — cannot be answered from published statistics and will require proxy construction (branch/ATM counts, payout announcements, beneficiary counts) rather than a dataset.

description: Searches for a Kancelarija za Kosovo i Metohiju published report on banking access / economic conditions for Serbs returned no such document; results were dominated by CBK reports instead.

result.result_summary: Query 'Kancelarija za Kosovo i Metohiju izveštaj ekonomija Srba bankarske usluge' returned bqk-kos.org PDFs and press items, no Kancelarija publication.

why_it_matters: The Belgrade institutional side may communicate only via press statements rather than periodic reports, which changes the collection method from document harvesting to announcement monitoring.

description: Three candidate homepages (posted.co.rs, kim.gov.rs, gorazdevac.info) were inferred from entity names and news references rather than retrieved from a search result link; they are recorded with reduced confidence and access_status=unverified.

result.result_summary: Entities are unambiguously real and cited across multiple sr-language sources, but the exact canonical URL was not returned by a search result in this pass.

why_it_matters: These are among the highest-value direct sources in the cell, so URL resolution should be prioritised in the deterministic liveness pass rather than treated as optional.

description: No source quantifying informal or parallel transfer channels (hand-carried cash, informal remittance/hawala-style flows, cross-boundary cash couriering) in Serbian-majority Kosovo was located in sr or en.

result.result_summary: Coverage is qualitative — dinar shortages, withdrawal caps, crossing-point branches — with no volume estimates from any institution, NGO or academic source.

why_it_matters: Parallel-channel volume is a named topic of this cell; its absence should be reported as a structural data gap rather than filled by inference.

description: This cell is Serbian-language by design; Albanian-language (sq) searching was not performed here beyond incidental results, since sq coverage belongs to sibling cells.

result.result_summary: sr-language searching was primary and mandatory-language coverage was met; en was used only for cross-checking (RFE/RL, BIRN, CBK English editions).

why_it_matters: Any sq-language regulator or outlet describing banking in Serbian-majority municipalities may be missed by this cell and must be picked up by the sq cells.

description: No GAP Institute report dedicated specifically to payment statistics, cards or cash usage surfaced in Albanian or English searching; GAP's banking coverage appears embedded in broader public-finance and business-environment analyses.

result.result_summary: Only tangential GAP outputs (market access, business profiles) were retrievable via search; the publications index itself was not enumerated.

why_it_matters: GAP may still hold relevant material behind an unindexed publications listing — the gap is discovery, not necessarily absence.

description: bqk-kos.org returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain fetch of the Working Papers page.

result.result_summary: 403 on https://bqk-kos.org/financial-stability/analysis-and-research/working-papers/?lang=en; page is search-indexed and referenced, so it is treated as bot-defended-but-live, NOT dead.

why_it_matters: The single most important research series in this cell needs a browser-grade collector; a naive HTTP collector would silently record it as unavailable.

description: No consolidated, publicly searchable thesis/dissertation repository was found for the University of Prishtina Faculty of Economics.

result.result_summary: Searches in Albanian returned faculty pages and scattered Academia.edu copies of UP master theses, but no institutional ETD system.

why_it_matters: The largest producer of Kosovo economics theses is not systematically harvestable; coverage depends on Academia.edu/Google Scholar scraps and defence announcements.

description: Serbian-language academic output from Kosovo (University of Pristina temporarily settled in Kosovska Mitrovica) on cash/payments was not located in this pass.

result.result_summary: Serbian queries surfaced media and NBS/regulatory material on the dinar ban rather than academic or think-tank research; no sr-language repository identified.

why_it_matters: Cash usage in Serb-majority municipalities is the most distinctive cash story in Kosovo and is under-covered by sq/en sources.

description: The NGO Aktiv website URL was inferred from the organisation's name rather than confirmed via a fetched link in results.

result.result_summary: Aktiv's role was evidenced through media citations of its Mitrovica-based analysts; the domain itself is a confident but unverified guess.

why_it_matters: Downstream verification must confirm the domain before the source is treated as live.

description: No public, downloadable list of licensed private security / cash-in-transit companies in Kosovo was found. Searches in Albanian for 'kompanitë private të sigurisë', 'transport i parave dhe vlerave' and 'bartja e parave' returned only the MPBAP division page describing the licensing function, plus unrelated vehicle-registration and occupational-safety pages.

result.result_summary: Regulator identified (MPBAP Division for Private Security Services); register itself not published online as far as this run could determine.

why_it_matters: Cash-in-transit and ATM-replenishment operators are the physical backbone of cash circulation and a direct adjacency for cash-management and ATM services. Without the register, the operator universe for Kosovo cannot be enumerated from open sources.

description: No named Kosovo-based cash-in-transit or cash-management operator was identified. An English search returned only global CIT vendors (Brink's, Loomis, G4S Serbia) with no evidence of a Kosovo entity; searches did not surface a Kosovo CIT company website.

result.result_summary: Zero Kosovo-specific CIT operators confirmed; only an insurer's bank/cash-transit product page indirectly evidences the market exists.

why_it_matters: Leaves a blind spot on who services ATMs and bank cash centres in Kosovo — a core actor class for this cell.

description: bqk-kos.org returned HTTP 403 Forbidden on an automated fetch of the time-series page. This is treated as a bot-defence hypothesis, not evidence the page is dead — the same domain's pages are indexed and linked throughout BQK navigation.

result.result_summary: BQK content is reachable to humans but resistant to naive automated fetching; collection will need browser-like requests.

why_it_matters: BQK is the single most important source in this cell; the collection pipeline must be designed around its bot defences from the start.

description: The Posta e Kosovës payment-services page was fetched successfully but discloses no money-transfer partner (no Western Union/MoneyGram branding), no postal money-order product detail, and no branch/counter count — only zero-commission bill payment and Vala mobile top-ups.

result.result_summary: Postal financial services confirmed to exist but with no network or product data published at the landing page level.

why_it_matters: The postal counter network is the widest rural cash-service footprint in Kosovo; its size and product mix must be obtained elsewhere (annual reports, procurement notices, or direct request).

description: No established Albanian or Serbian term for 'cash-in-transit' as an industry category was found in use on Kosovo sources. Candidate constructions used ('transport i parave dhe vlerave', 'bartja e parave') did not retrieve sector content, and no sr-language equivalent ('transport novca i vrednosti') was tested against Kosovo-domain content.

result.result_summary: Local-language vocabulary gap for the cash-logistics sub-domain.

why_it_matters: Local-language search is mandatory for this run; without a working local term the CIT sub-cell cannot be searched natively, which likely explains the empty operator findings above.

description: The Albanian term 'sigurim' is heavily overloaded: it means both 'insurance' and 'security'. Searching 'kompani sigurimi ... Kosovë' returns insurance companies and motor-insurance products rather than private security firms; the correct term for security services is 'shërbimet private të sigurisë' / 'kompanitë private të sigurisë'.

result.result_summary: Noisy-term warning recorded for the glossary.

why_it_matters: Prevents repeated wasted queries and false-positive sources in later collection rounds for this cell.

description: No evidence was found of a Ria Money Transfer country presence page or agent locator for Kosovo, and no confirmation of MTO partnership arrangements with named Kosovo banks (Raiffeisen, ProCredit, TEB) beyond Raiffeisen's general transfer pages and a Wise cross-border partnership at RBI group level.

result.result_summary: MTO-to-bank agency relationships in Kosovo remain unmapped.

why_it_matters: Which MTO pays out through which bank branch network determines whether remittance cash arrives at a bank counter/ATM or at a standalone agent — the key routing question for cash and ATM demand.

description: No Serbian-language (sr) job portal, complaint channel or event listing specific to Kosovo/XK was found. Serbian-language searches ('posao Kosovo banka platne kartice specijalista konkurs oglas') returned almost exclusively Serbia, Bosnia and Montenegro employers (Infostud, NLB RS, Addiko, Erste, Adriatic Bank) with no Kosovo-domiciled institution.

result.result_summary: sr-language querying produced a usable role glossary (platne kartice, bankomat, oglas za posao, konkurs, specijalista) but zero Kosovo-specific indirect sources.

why_it_matters: The sr-speaking north-Kosovo banking segment is a real market slice; if its hiring, complaint and event signals exist they are not discoverable via mainstream sr job boards, so the cell currently has an sr blind spot.

description: No independent web domain for Shoqata e Bankave te Kosoves (Kosovo Banking Association) was surfaced. The only reachable descriptions of the association sit on a member bank's page and on the Albanian Association of Banks site.

result.result_summary: Association confirmed to exist and to co-organise sector fora (e.g. an October 2023 cybersecurity-in-banking forum with AAB Albania), but no own events/agenda page was located.

why_it_matters: A banking association's conference agendas and member statistics are one of the richest indirect channels; without its own domain the cell must reconstruct its activity from member-bank and partner-association pages, losing timeliness.

description: No dedicated Kosovo financial ombudsman institution or standalone banking-ombudsman complaint-statistics publication was identified. Complaint handling appears to sit inside BQK's Divizioni i Ankesave te Shfrytezuesve te Sherbimeve Financiare rather than an independent ombudsman.

result.result_summary: Searches in sq surfaced the BQK complaints division and portal (ankesat.bqk-kos.org) and the general consumer-protection legal framework, but no separate ombudsman body publishing card/ATM complaint series.

why_it_matters: The cell's rationale assumed an ombudsman data stream; in XK that stream is regulator-internal, so complaint statistics are only as granular as BQK's annual report chooses to be.

description: No recurring Kosovo-specific payments or cards conference (with a published agenda and speaker list) was found. Payments content appears only as sessions inside broader events: the BQK regional crypto/digital-money conference, KosICT, and the region-wide Balkan Payment Forum.

result.result_summary: No 'Kosovo Payments Summit' style standing event located in sq or en searching.

why_it_matters: Conference-slide leakage of transaction volumes is a core mechanism for this cell; with no national payments conference, the cell must lean on regional events and regulator conferences, which are less XK-specific.

description: LinkedIn content for Kosovo payment executives is behind login and its terms restrict automated collection; The Banker and Euromoney award citations are behind paywalls.

result.result_summary: Named executive signals were only partially visible via search snippets (e.g. a Head of Cards and POS Business at TEB; a Head of Retail Banking Group at BKT Kosova; a new Head of Channel Management at ProCredit Bank Kosova).

why_it_matters: The two highest-yield indirect channels for this cell (executive posts, award citations) are the two most access-constrained, pushing the collection design toward manual/licensed rather than automated methods.

description: No URL in this slice was fetched or liveness-checked; all URLs come from search-result metadata and snippets.

result.result_summary: Candidates are recorded with confidence scores only; paywall/login flags on thebanker.com, euromoney.com and linkedin.com are hypotheses, not observed HTTP verdicts.

why_it_matters: The downstream deterministic verification pass must resolve these before any source is treated as reachable or dead.

description: No ASK survey or table was found that measures payment instrument choice at the point of sale (cash vs card vs transfer) in the way ECB SPACE or a diary study would.

result.result_summary: ABEF captures consumption by COICOP purpose but, from everything surfaced, not the instrument used to pay; the TIK survey covers e-shopping incidence, not payment mix.

why_it_matters: The cell's headline hypothesis — ASK as the demand-side counterpart on cash usage — holds only indirectly. Any cash-usage read from ASK will be inferred (consumption minus card volumes), not measured, unless a payment-diary module exists in unpublished microdata.

description: Search for an ASK enterprise-side ICT/e-commerce survey release returned no ASK-hosted result; all hits were Eurostat/INE/CyStat equivalents.

result.result_summary: The PxWeb folder is named 'ICT in Households and Enterprise', implying enterprise tables exist, but no enterprise release page or PDF was located in this pass.

why_it_matters: Merchant-side e-commerce adoption is the direct input to acquiring/CNP sizing; if ASK does not field the enterprise module, that evidence must come from CBK or private sources instead.

description: ABEF periodicity changed from annual to multi-year.

result.result_summary: Serbian-language sources state that from 2015 the household consumption survey moved from annual collection to a two-to-three-year cycle.

why_it_matters: A collector scheduled for annual ABEF updates will produce false 'missing data' alarms; consumption denominators must be interpolated between rounds using national accounts HFCE instead.

description: Microdata access route for ABEF, SILC and TIK was not established in this pass.

result.result_summary: No public microdata catalogue, anonymised-file request form or research-access policy for ASK surveys was surfaced by the queries run.

why_it_matters: Cross-tabulating cash behaviour by income decile or urban/rural requires microdata; without a documented access route this remains a manual, relationship-based ask to ASK (infoask@rks-gov.net).

description: ASKdata PxWeb uses ASP.NET __doPostBack navigation, so subject folders have no stable deep-link URLs in the rendered HTML.

result.result_summary: The fetched database root listed 26 subject areas but exposed no per-folder hrefs; only the Geographical data folder appeared with a canonical /pxweb/en/ASKdata/ASKdata__<Folder>/ path via search.

why_it_matters: HTML scraping of ASKdata will be brittle. The collector should target the PxWeb REST API path pattern (/api/v1/{lang}/ASKdata/...) rather than the web UI.

description: No distinct Serbian-language institution named 'Zavod za statistiku Kosova' exists; the correct Serbian rendering is 'Agencija za statistiku Kosova'.

result.result_summary: The seed query using 'Zavod za statistiku' returned Montenegrin (MONSTAT) and Croatian (DZS) offices; only 'Agencija za statistiku Kosova' resolves to ASK's own /sr/ path.

why_it_matters: Using the wrong Serbian alias pulls in neighbouring countries' statistics and contaminates any automated query set. 'Zavod za statistiku' should be flagged as a noisy term for XK.

description: No Kosovo commercial bank publishes a Basel Pillar-3 style public disclosure document ('shpalosja e informatave', 'Pillar 3') that I could locate. Searches in sq and en returned only EU/Turkish bank Pillar-3 reports and CBK material.

result.result_summary: Zero Kosovo-bank Pillar-3 documents found; the cell's 'pillar-3/disclosure documents' assumption does not hold for XK.

why_it_matters: Risk-weighted, standardised disclosure tables that would give comparable per-bank operational data do not exist here; the collection design must rely on narrative annual reports plus audited IFRS notes instead.

description: Serbian-language ('sr') disclosure by individual Kosovo commercial banks was not found. Serbian-language queries using 'godišnji izveštaj', 'bankomati', 'POS terminali' returned only the Central Bank of Kosovo's own Serbian editions, not bank-level reports.

result.result_summary: Bank-level sr-language reporting appears absent; banks publish in sq and en only.

why_it_matters: sr-language monitoring for this cell should be pointed at CBK/aggregate publishers, not at the commercial banks; expecting sr bank sources would produce false negatives in coverage scoring.

description: Ziraat Bank Kosova's corporate site surfaced no annual-report or financial-statements section in sq or en searching; only branch locations and product pages were found.

result.result_summary: Smallest banks in the market may not self-publish reports at all.

why_it_matters: Per-institution coverage of the cell will be incomplete at the tail; those banks must be covered via CBK aggregates or the business registry, and the gap should be recorded rather than treated as a crawl failure.

description: bkt-ks.com returned 'unable to verify the first certificate' on two separate paths, and the ProCredit sq annual-reports path returned HTTP 404 while the EN equivalent served fine.

result.result_summary: Two fetch failures that are almost certainly TLS-config and URL-rename issues, not dead sources — search engines index recent documents from both domains.

why_it_matters: A naive liveness check would mark BKT Kosova (a systemic bank) as dead and drop the highest-value domestic disclosure from the corpus.

description: Only TEB's report was directly text-extracted in this run and it did carry hard operational figures (POS terminals 5,593; branches 34 vs 30). It was NOT confirmed that Raiffeisen, ProCredit, NLB, BKT, BPB or Banka Ekonomike state ATM/POS/card counts in their reports — that remains a hypothesis for the extraction pass.

result.result_summary: One of seven bank report archives verified to contain the target metrics.

why_it_matters: Usefulness scores for the un-extracted archives are structural expectations, not evidence; the extraction pass should confirm per-bank before the corpus is treated as a per-institution ATM/POS panel.

description: No standalone, group-published Kosovo card/POS/ATM statistical dataset was found for any parent group — Kosovo card, terminal and digital-channel numbers appear only embedded in narrative sections of annual reports/presentations, never as a downloadable data series.

result.result_summary: Searches across RBI, ProCredit Holding, NLB, TEB, Ziraat and BKT returned only PDF reports and presentations; no data portal, XLS annex or API surfaced.

why_it_matters: Collection for A4 payment/card statistics from group sources must be PDF-extraction based, with manual QA; automated tabular ingestion is not available.

description: Serbian-language (sr) searching produced no group-level Kosovo banking disclosures beyond NLB's own English/Slovene material.

result.result_summary: Query 'NLB grupa godišnji izveštaj Kosovo banka tržišni udeo kartice' returned only NLB group English pages, Wikipedia entries and NLB Montenegro reports — no Serbian-language parent-group publication covering Kosovo card/terminal statistics.

why_it_matters: For this cell, sr is a low-yield language: the relevant parent groups publish in en, de, sl, tr and sq. Effort should be redirected accordingly, but this must be recorded rather than assumed.

description: No Kosovo-specific disclosure was located at the BNP Paribas group level (as opposed to TEB A.Ş. / TEB Kosovo level).

result.result_summary: Searches surfaced TEB Kosovo and TEB Türkiye reports but nothing where BNP Paribas group reporting breaks out Kosovo; BNP's link is indirect via the TEB joint venture (BNP Paribas Fortis Yatırımlar Holding).

why_it_matters: Analysts should not expect Kosovo lines in BNP Paribas universal registration documents; the TEB chain is the usable disclosure path.

description: Several hub URLs in this slice were inferred from publisher structure or cited inside search results rather than returned as direct hits (ProCredit Holding IR hub, ziraatbank-kosova.com, kap.org.tr English path).

result.result_summary: Recorded with reduced confidence scores and flagged here; no fetch was performed, so nothing is asserted about liveness.

why_it_matters: The deterministic liveness pass should treat these as priority checks; failures are likely path changes, not dead publishers.

description: Searches in sq (bankomat, kompani jo-bankare) and en for an independent/white-label ATM deploying company in Kosovo returned only bank-owned ATM networks (Raiffeisen, ProCredit, TEB, NLB) and generic banking articles.

result.result_summary: No evidence found of a non-bank Independent ATM Deployer (IAD) operating a branded ATM estate in Kosovo. ATM deployment appears to sit with banks; processing may be outsourced (e.g. Quipu) but the estate is bank-owned.

why_it_matters: The cell hypothesis that ATM activity is migrating to non-bank independents is not supported for Kosovo on current evidence; the non-bank story here is wallets/EMIs and processing, not ATM estates. Downstream analysis should not assume an IAD segment exists.

description: No licensed Kosovo payment institution or e-money institution was found publishing its own periodic transaction/volume statistics (counts, values, merchant or terminal numbers) on a recurring basis.

result.result_summary: Actor-level numbers exist only as one-off marketing or partner-press claims (e.g. Quipu's cards/ATM/POS/monthly-transaction figures, Paysera launch claims). Nothing resembling a recurring statistical release from a non-bank licensee was located.

why_it_matters: The cell's premise that non-bank licensees publish volumes to attract merchants/investors holds only weakly in Kosovo. Non-bank share will have to be inferred from BQK aggregates (digital-wallet series, card/POS series) plus episodic corporate claims, with explicit uncertainty.

description: The canonical BQK list of licensed financial institutions (April 2026 PDF) could not be retrieved: HTTP 403 Forbidden on fetch.

result.result_summary: 403 on https://bqk-kos.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Lista-e-institucioneve-financiare-22.04.2026-ALB.pdf; the URL is search-indexed and the parent section page is reachable, so this is bot defence rather than a dead link. Recorded as unverified, not dead.

why_it_matters: The single most important actor-map artefact for this cell needs a browser-like fetch path (headers/session) in the collection pipeline; a naive HTTP client will silently produce an empty actor map.

description: Serbian-language searching surfaced BQK's own sr publications and terminology but no Kosovo-specific non-bank payment actors, associations or trade press in Serbian.

result.result_summary: sr queries returned Montenegrin/Bosnian regulators (CBCG, Raiffeisen BiH) and BQK sr documents; no Serbian-language Kosovo fintech/PSP actor sources found. Serbian-language coverage of this cell appears to run through the regulator only.

why_it_matters: Any Serb-majority-municipality payment channels (including parallel/Serbian-dinar cash channels) are invisible to this cell's current source set, which biases cash-usage and non-bank-channel estimates.

description: No Kosovo-specific published statistics from the international card schemes (Visa, Mastercard) or from a domestic card switch were located.

result.result_summary: Searches for a Kosovo domestic card switch/scheme and for scheme-published country volumes returned nothing Kosovo-specific; card acceptance appears to run on Visa/Mastercard via bank and third-party processors with no public country data release.

why_it_matters: Scheme-side corroboration of card and POS statistics is unavailable, so BQK remains effectively the sole measurement authority for this market — a single-source dependency worth flagging in any conclusion.

description: Both bqk-kos.org and bankassoc-kos.com returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to automated WebFetch requests on the two highest-value pointer pages (licensed-institutions hub and KBA members page).

result.result_summary: 403 on https://bqk-kos.org/mbikeqyrja-financiare/institucionet-financiare-te-licencuara-2/?lang=en and on https://www.bankassoc-kos.com/Al/anetaret/. Both domains are heavily indexed by search engines and serve many PDFs, so this is bot defence, not a dead site — treated as a hypothesis, not a verdict.

why_it_matters: The collection pipeline for this cell must use a browser-like client with realistic headers; a naive HTTP fetcher will report Kosovo's two most important pointer sources as unavailable.

description: No dedicated Kosovo insurance-industry association ('Shoqata e Siguruesve të Kosovës') was confirmed to exist as a separate body with its own member/statistics site.

result.result_summary: sq/en searches returned the Albanian insurers' association (shoqatasiguruesve.al) and the Kosovo Insurance Bureau (BKS, bks-ks.org) instead. BKS appears to be the de facto sector body for Kosovo.

why_it_matters: Prevents a wasted search loop in later cells and redirects insurance-sector actor discovery to BKS plus the BQK licensed-insurers list.

description: A national open-data portal at open.rks-gov.net publishing ARBK or financial-sector datasets could not be confirmed.

result.result_summary: Search for the portal returned only ARBK's own sites and third-party mirrors (arbk.org, arbk.atlas-studio.eu); no open-data catalogue entry for business-registry or payments data surfaced.

why_it_matters: Bulk, machine-readable access to the actor universe likely has to come from third-party mirrors rather than an official open-data endpoint, which raises verification cost.

description: No standalone public list of payment-system participants (RTGS/interbank clearing members, card acquirers/issuers) was located as a separate BQK register page.

result.result_summary: Payment-system participant information appears embedded in BQK annual reports and in the general licensed-institutions list rather than in a dedicated participants register.

why_it_matters: A4 card/ATM/POS work must derive the participant universe from annual-report chapters and the licensed list, not from a single clean register.

description: Serbian-language (sr) pointer coverage for Kosovo financial registers is thin.

result.result_summary: sr search surfaced BQK's Serbian legal-framework PDFs and the Serbian Official Gazette version of the banking law, but no sr-language member list, sr register index page, or sr association site specific to Kosovo.

why_it_matters: sr-language monitoring for this cell will have to rely on document-level Serbian translations of Albanian originals; sr-only sources for Kosovo banking actors may not exist, which should temper expectations for sr coverage targets.

description: Serbian-language (sr, Cyrillic) searching for IFI Kosovo financial-inclusion/payments data returned no IFI Kosovo material.

result.result_summary: The query 'Светска банка Косово финансијска укљученост подаци платни промет извештај' returned only Serbia/North Macedonia banking documents (NBS payment statistics, KPMG AML risk assessment, WB Serbia projects) — no World Bank/IMF/EBRD Kosovo dataset or report.

why_it_matters: IFIs do not appear to publish Kosovo financial-access material in Serbian, and Serbian-language searching is additionally distorted by the political naming of Kosovo. Serbian-language monitoring should therefore be aimed at local/Serbian institutional sources, not at the IFI cell.

description: No Albanian-language IFI-hosted dataset or statistical publication for Kosovo was found on worldbank.org / imf.org / ebrd.com / eib.org / ifc.org.

result.result_summary: Albanian-language searching surfaced Kosovo domestic institutions (BQK, universities, media) that cite IFI data, but no IFI-domain Albanian statistical release.

why_it_matters: Confirms that for this cell, English is the working language of the primary sources, and that local-language coverage must be achieved indirectly via domestic documents that quote IFI figures.

description: EBRD Banking Environment and Performance Survey (BEPS) microdata is not obtainable.

result.result_summary: EBRD explicitly states BEPS underlying data are not publicly available due to confidentiality agreements with participating banks; only derived research and reports are accessible.

why_it_matters: Prevents bank-level supply-side analysis for Kosovo from EBRD; collection must be limited to published research outputs.

description: Kosovo POS-terminals-per-100,000-adults could not be confirmed in the search pass as a published IFI series.

result.result_summary: Search results confirmed the IMF FAS ATM-per-100k series for Kosovo (FRED KOSFCAANUM) and global POS commentary, but no Kosovo-specific POS series was surfaced; an sq-language BQK-linked document quoted POS-per-100k figures for 2015/2018, implying such data exists but may be sourced domestically or from a WB study rather than a live IFI series.

why_it_matters: POS density is a core cell indicator; the collection pipeline must verify whether FAS publishes Kosovo POS variables before relying on it, and be prepared to fall back on CBK data.

description: Kosovo is not a MONEYVAL member and has no MONEYVAL mutual evaluation report. MONEYVAL covers Council of Europe member states (plus specified jurisdictions), and Kosovo is not a Council of Europe member. The seed query's premise ('MONEYVAL Kosovo mutual evaluation report') does not correspond to an existing document.

result.result_summary: No Kosovo MER exists. The functional substitute is the Council of Europe/EU PECK and PECK II project assessments (2018 round), which applied FATF/MONEYVAL methodology outside the formal evaluation procedure. FATF also lists no mutual evaluation for Kosovo.

why_it_matters: Analysts expecting a MONEYVAL cash-intensity assessment for Kosovo will find nothing and may wrongly conclude the data is missing entirely; the PECK II assessment and the EC country report AML chapter must be used instead, and regional MONEYVAL MERs used only as comparators.

description: No ECB or Eurosystem statistical series covers Kosovo's payment, card, ATM/POS or cash-circulation data, because Kosovo is unilaterally euroised without any monetary agreement with the EU (unlike San Marino, Monaco, Andorra, Vatican).

result.result_summary: ECB payments statistics, the SPACE study and euro banknote circulation series exclude Kosovo from their reporting population. ECB material on Kosovo is limited to policy/research framing of unilateral euroisation, not country data.

why_it_matters: Any figure on euro cash circulating in Kosovo cannot come from the ECB and must be a domestic (CBK) or estimated figure; treating an ECB series as the source would be an error. This makes CBK and EC-report figures the effective primary layer for A4 topics.

description: As of the searches conducted, Kosovo does not appear on the European Payments Council's list of countries within the SEPA schemes' geographical scope, while Albania, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Moldova and Serbia have been included.

result.result_summary: EPC list versions v7.0 (May 2025) and v8.0 (Dec 2025) were located; regional inclusion announcements exist for Montenegro/Albania (Nov 2024) and Serbia (May 2025), but no Kosovo inclusion announcement was found. Kosovo's status was not verified inside the v8.0 PDF text in this pass.

why_it_matters: SEPA scope membership is the pivotal structural variable for Kosovo's payment market; its absence means cross-border euro payments remain correspondent-bank priced, which materially shapes demand for domestic payment infrastructure.

description: Serbian-language search for EU documentation on Kosovo's financial sector returns almost no Kosovo-specific material; general Cyrillic queries surface Serbian and North Macedonian national documents instead.

result.result_summary: The only reliable Serbian-language EU channel identified is the EEAS EU Office in Kosovo _sr document track (e.g. the SWD Kosovo report translations). No Serbian-language Eurostat, ECB or Council of Europe material specific to Kosovo payments was found.

why_it_matters: Serbian-language coverage for this cell must be sourced from the EEAS delegation site rather than from generic search; otherwise the sr language requirement produces noise from Serbia proper.

description: Several key terms are ambiguous across the sq/sr/en searches for this cell.

result.result_summary: 'Raporti i Komisionit Evropian' returns Albania's own EC report far more often than Kosovo's; 'платни промет' returns Serbian national payment-system material; 'Kosovo report' collides with EU Election Observation Mission reports; MONEYVAL queries return Serbia's APML pages. Queries must be pinned with 'Kosovë/Kosovo/Косово' plus a year and preferably a site filter.

why_it_matters: Without disambiguation the collector will ingest Albanian and Serbian national documents as if they were Kosovo sources, corrupting any A4 statistics baseline.

description: No EU-level machine-readable dataset of Kosovo card, ATM or POS statistics was identified in this cell.

result.result_summary: Eurostat enlargement coverage for Kosovo is macro/social/ICT-oriented; the EC country report and ERP carry payment-infrastructure narrative rather than structured series. Concrete figures found in passing (KIPS volumes/values, cash transaction cap) trace back to the CBK, i.e. outside this cell.

why_it_matters: For A4 topics the EU/European layer supplies validation, framing and policy conditionality but not the primary numbers; the run must not expect this cell to yield the core statistical series.

description: No specific Kosovo public tender for ATMs (bankomat), POS terminals, card personalisation or a payment switch could be surfaced through general web search in any of sq, sr or en. Search engines index the e-Prokurimi document viewer only sparsely.

result.result_summary: Five language-varied queries returned the portals and buyers but zero identifiable ATM/POS/payment-system notice. The portal's ASP.NET document viewer (DokumentPodaciFrm.aspx?id=) appears to be largely invisible to search engines.

why_it_matters: Item-level discovery in this cell cannot rely on web search; it must go through the OCDS bulk dataset or the portal's own search UI. Any collection design that assumes Google-indexed tender pages will systematically under-report.

description: TED does not carry Kosovo domestic procurement, because Kosovo is neither an EU member nor an EEA party subject to the EU procurement directives.

result.result_summary: TED searches surfaced only general TED documentation; no Kosovo domestic notices. Only EU external-action/IPA contracts naming Kosovo as place of performance would appear.

why_it_matters: The TED leg of this cell has structurally low yield and should be scoped down to EU external-action contracts and the EU Funding & Tenders/enlargement channel rather than treated as a parallel to e-Prokurimi.

description: No dedicated 'calls for tenders' portal for the EU Office in Kosovo / EU Special Representative was located; EU-funded procurement for Kosovo appears to be routed through indirect management with implementers (UNDP, IOM) or through central EC systems.

result.result_summary: Searches returned IPA action documents on enlargement.ec.europa.eu but no Kosovo-specific EU tender listing page.

why_it_matters: Donor-funded payment-infrastructure procurement is fragmented across implementers, so the collection plan needs several small feeds rather than one EU portal; risk of missing contracts is real.

description: Whether full tender dossiers (technical specifications with quantities) on e-Prokurimi are downloadable anonymously or require a registered economic-operator account was not established in this pass.

result.result_summary: Notice-level documents appear publicly addressable; dossier-level access unconfirmed.

why_it_matters: The quantity-level intelligence this cell exists to capture lives in the dossier, not the notice. If dossiers are gated, the collection method must fall back to award notices, OSHP decisions and NAO audit reports.

description: Serbian-language coverage of Kosovo procurement is thin online. Queries in sr returned regional aggregators rather than Kosovo institutional pages, apart from the Serbian (sr-Latn) interface of prokurimihapur.org and the e-Prokurimi portal's own multilingual notice versions.

result.result_summary: sr terms (javne nabavke, bankomati, POS terminali, obavestenje o ugovoru, platni sistem) produced Serbia/BiH/Montenegro portals more often than Kosovo records.

why_it_matters: Serbian-language search will not independently discover Kosovo tenders; sr terms are useful for matching inside documents but not as a discovery channel, so sq must be the primary discovery language.
